author: Roger Gorączniak (Picasa user 'Roger Gor')
attribution: Photo by Roger Gorączniak, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: KSW 30 weigh-in, Poznań, age 24. Near-frontal face and upper body flexing the right arm, gritted-teeth grin. Sharp and well lit. Shows the ear shape (cauliflower), nose, brows and torso; he was very lean and had a shaved-sides strip haircut and a thin chin-strap beard then, so use it for bone structure, not for the current hair or beard.

author: Roger Gorączniak (Picasa user 'Roger Gor')
attribution: Photo by Roger Gorączniak, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Same weigh-in; Gamrot is on the left in red briefs, full body head to shins, fists up in a face-off pose. Good for limb proportions and leanness (2015). No tattoos on him; the tattooed man on the right is his opponent Rodrigo Cavalheiro.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (photographer not credited), via ESPN
notes: Frontal head and shoulders, neutral expression. Best source for current face proportions, the right-cheek mole, ears, beard shape and buzz cut. Warm orange studio grade. Official UFC studio portrait served by ESPN's headshot CDN; date is the CDN Last-Modified header, so the shoot is on or before that date.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (photographer not credited), via ESPN
notes: Full body, three-quarter turned to the viewer's right, neutral face. Black UFC shorts with grey and white slash print. No tattoos anywhere visible. Arms hang with elbows slightly bent, gloves at hip height. Official UFC studio portrait served by ESPN's headshot CDN; date is the CDN Last-Modified header, so the shoot is on or before that date.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (photographer not credited), via ESPN
notes: Full body, turned the other way, smiling. Same shorts; red 'GAMROT' wordmark runs down his left thigh. Shows the body hair (light chest and lower-abdomen hair) and leg shape. Official UFC studio portrait served by ESPN's headshot CDN; date is the CDN Last-Modified header, so the shoot is on or before that date.

author: Pat Danna / Cageside Press
notes: UFC 327 ceremonial weigh-in face-off with Esteban Ribovics. Gamrot (left) is in near-profile showing his RIGHT side: the nose line, the beard, the cauliflower right ear and the faded back and sides of the buzz cut. Only true profile in the set.

author: Cageside Press (no photo credit on the page)
notes: Most recent photo (Aug 2026). Near-frontal, smiling, white shirt. Skin-coloured tape across the nose bridge (temporary), thin chain at the neck. Warm/red stage light.

author: Cageside Press (no photo credit on the page)
notes: Three-quarter view of his right side, head tilted, black zip top. Shows the cheekbone and jaw line under the beard and the brow shape.

author: Cageside Press (no photo credit on the page; looks like a press-conference video frame)
